questions.question:
Which of the following is the broadcast address for a network address and subnet mask
combination of 192.168.10.0 / 255.255.255.240?
questions.explanation: Provisional: 255.255.255.240 is /28, leaving four host bits. The final four bits all set to 1 give the broadcast address; for the subnet starting at 192.168.10.0, that is 192.168.10.15. The source lists .18, .47, .54, and .125, so none is correct. The printed key selects .47, which belongs to a different /28 subnet.

optionExplanations.A: 192.168.10.18 is outside the .0/28 block, which ends at .15.
optionExplanations.B: 192.168.10.47 is not the broadcast address for the stated subnet; the source key marks it incorrectly.

files.sourcePdf: Fundamentals of Computer Networks/FCN/fcn sample q_1.pdf
files.answerEvidenceSummary: No explicit answer key or option-intersecting PDF highlight annotation was detected.

verification.reason: Visual inspection confirms the source marks B (192.168.10.47), but that is not the broadcast address for 192.168.10.0/28. A /28 has a block size of 16; the subnet spans .0 through .15 and its directed broadcast is .15. None of the four printed choices is correct, so the item is quarantined rather than repaired by inventing a choice.
